item.description:
Leading from Anywhere: The Essential Guide to Managing Remote Teams

Summary

“Leading from Anywhere: The Essential Guide to Managing Remote Teams” by David Burkus is a comprehensive guide that addresses the challenges and opportunities of managing remote teams effectively. The book provides insights on how to build culture remotely, maintain productivity, and ensure team cohesion despite geographical distances. Burkus explores various aspects of remote leadership, from hiring and onboarding new team members to maintaining effective communication and cultivating trust. The book is grounded in research and real-world examples, making it a practical resource for anyone leading or participating in remote work setups.
